page.overview:
Who is Hermione Bagwa?

Hermione "Harmony" Bagwa was a female human who worked as a waitress alongside Wanda and FLO at Dex's Diner, an eatery owned by Dexter Jettster and located on the streets of CoCo Town, Coruscant. She grew up within Coruscant's underworld. Shortly before the onset of the Clone Wars, Bagwa was present in the diner when Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi visited Jettster regarding a mysterious saberdart.

Hermione Bagwa was portrayed by Australian actress Susie Porter in the 2002 film Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones, the second installment of the Star Wars prequel trilogy.

Early production notes for Attack of the Clones suggest that Bagwa was originally going to be Dexter Jettster's wife instead of his waitress, but this direction was ultimately abandoned. During filming, Porter delivered waitress lines as both Hermione and FLO, the latter who was the only one to have a speaking part in the finished film.
